fact: Daz and Zalthir freeze after realizing something is wrong behind them.
source_quote: Daz and Zalthir both froze. Their passive perception caught something wrong in the darkness behind them.
subject: passive perception success

fact: One insight roll came up a natural 20 and Daz rolled a 17.
source_quote: On the follow-up insight rolls, one came up a natural 20 and Daz rolled a 17.
subject: insight rolls

fact: Zalthir deduces the pursuers are scouts from the prison the party escaped.
source_quote: The figures stalking them were scouts from the very prison they had escaped
subject: scout identification

fact: Zalthir deduces that the scouts are Drow from the prison.
source_quote: Zalthir's mind raced through what he knew of Drow tactics... The figures stalking them were scouts from the very prison they had escaped
subject: Zalthir

fact: The Drow scouts appear to have the party's scent.
source_quote: The scouts seemed to have their scent.
subject: Drow scouts

fact: Zalthir rolls a natural 20 on a history check.
source_quote: A natural-20 history check reminded Zalthir
subject: history check success

fact: Zalthir recalls from a monastery tome that killing the scouts will not stop the main hunting party.
source_quote: a musty tome from his monastery, which taught that killing the scouts would not stop the main force
subject: Zalthir

fact: Zalthir owns a musty tome from his monastery regarding Drow tactics.
source_quote: a musty tome from his monastery
subject: musty tome

fact: Stool is unable to mind-control the Drow because he has only four spores.
source_quote: Stool cannot mind-control drow, since he has only four spores.
subject: Stool

fact: The party decides to run rather than hide or ambush.
source_quote: the decision was made quickly: they would run.
subject: decision to run

fact: Stool urges the party to run.
subject: Stool
